outcome: Perceptions of program effectiveness in developing skills consistent with AAMFT Core Competencies
cohort: The participants were 234 graduate students enrolled in U.S.-based Master's programs accredited by the Commission of Accreditation for Marriage and Family Therapy Education (COAMFTE).
finding: Only one-third of MFT students felt well-prepared across all competency domains, with significant differences in perceived preparation noted by race, gender, program delivery mode, and student status.
